description: a short, darker street branching east off elm street, its one working streetlight pooled in a cone of sickly yellow. the buildings here are older — a shuttered laundromat, a pawn shop with the grate pulled down. a bus bench and a jutting corner of brick wall at the mouth of the alley make this the spot where two sidewalks meet at a blind corner. the taco bell sign glows faintly behind you, a few doors back, the only warmth on the block.

environment.noise: distant traffic, the buzz of the taco bell sign
environment.smell: old brick, cold asphalt, wet garbage

name: Oak Street

exits.description: the blind corner where oak street runs back west into elm street, past the pawn shop grate — someone coming the other way is easy to walk straight into.
